# Internal lifecycle test fixture

This is synthetic test code, not an installable inference plugin. It is compiled only with BUILD_TESTING and written under build/testing, never dist.

test.lifecycle/events-v1 and events-v2 are independent marker tables. The environment probe supports demo.numeric comparisons against 10 and returns UNKNOWN for other names. Config: name (trace label), fail (creation rollback), query_v2 (query the bound provider slot). Additional entry symbols deliberately return invalid identities/descriptors. Errors and unload events are traced via CITLALI_TEST_TRACE. No inference, frontend or kernel implementation is included. Fixture protocol.h uses SDK headers only for this internal test; public installable packages must carry their headers.
